Grand Opening: Harlow & Finch – Dunmore Office

Harlow & Finch is delighted to announce the opening of our regional office in Dunmore. To mark the expansion, we are offering complimentary financial consultation services to the first 40 businesses that sign up through our Web site. Please note that only firms registered in Dunmore qualify for this special offer. It is not available to businesses operating in the other towns where we have offices.

Throughout the opening week, visitors to our Dunmore office can have a meeting with our senior financial adviser, Rosalind Achebe, for a private discussion of your investment planning and business strategy. We look forward to working with you to improve your financial performance.
